name: UsageReportIssue
title: DTx Usage API: why a request or a report was refused
description: The codes the DTx Usage API puts in OperationOutcome.issue.details.coding. Stage-1 codes refuse a report synchronously (HTTP 400, or 413 for BATCH_TOO_LARGE); request codes refuse the call itself; stage-2 codes are the reasons on a judged submission's Task. The authoritative list is packages/contract/src/reason-codes.ts; this file mirrors it for FHIR tooling.
